name: MUSE spectrometer and liquid hydrogen target

placements.note: PSI campus-grade site; the pi M1 area is not located in a fetched source.
placements.quote: using the Paul Scherrer Institute's PiM1 secondary beamline.

summary.plain: A liquid-hydrogen target in a vacuum chamber with a large set of detectors around it that track the electrons and muons scattered by the protons.
summary.technical: Non-magnetic large-acceptance spectrometer with beam-line tracking, a liquid hydrogen target and trigger vetoes such as the Target Chamber Post Veto.

technology.quote: MUSE uses a large-solid-angle, non-magnetic spectrometer to detect beam particles scattering from a liquid hydrogen cell contained within a vacuum chamber.
technology.value: Large-solid-angle, non-magnetic spectrometer detecting beam particles scattering from a liquid hydrogen cell in a vacuum chamber
